landing_page: Header / Floating Glass Navigation with Brand Logo SVG, nav links, Cart counter badge, and Admin panel toggle button

Kinetic Hero Section: Masked image entrance reveal animation, bold display headline 'Susu Sapi Pasteurisasi Murni, Segar Setiap Hari', bottle showcase, quick CTAs ('Pesan Sekarang', 'Lihat 10 Varian')
Editorial Marquee: Continuous drifting banner displaying '100% Susu Sapi Murni • Pasteurisasi Suhu Tepat • 10 Varian Rasa Premium • Tanpa Pengawet • Rp 15.000 / 350ml'
Flavor Showcase Section: 10 distinct milk flavor cards with hover micro-animations, color accent matching flavor, quantity controls, and 'Tambah ke Keranjang' quick action

Mix-Flavor Shopping Cart & Order Section: Floating or embedded cart builder. Pick multiple variants in one order, real-time price calculation (@ Rp 15.000/botol). Form inputs (Nama Lengkap, Nomor WhatsApp, Alamat Lengkap, Catatan). Action to save order to Database API and auto-redirect/open WhatsApp 081227646940 with pre-filled formatted order message
Bento Grid Quality & Farm Section: High-density feature bento showing Peternakan Murni, Sterilisasi Cold-Chain 4°C, 0% Pengawet, Kemasan Botol 350ml Higenis
Testimonial / Ulasan Pelanggan: Customer quotes with avatar badges and rating stars
Footer: Organic design with MilkyWay brand logo, direct WhatsApp CTA button (081227646940), social links, operating hours, and quick navigation
admin_panel: Admin Header & Navigation: Tab switcher between 'Overview Dashboard', 'Kelola Pesanan', 'Edit Konten Landing', and 'Live Chat Admin'
Overview Dashboard: Metric summary cards (Total Pesanan, Total Pendapatan, Pengunjung Hari Ini, Varian Terlaris) + Interactive daily traffic & orders chart using Recharts

Kelola Pesanan (Orders Table): Data table listing incoming orders with details (Order ID, Pelanggan, Phone, Varian & Jumlah, Total Harga, Tanggal, Status). Status dropdown/toggle to mark (Menunggu, Diproses, Dikirim, Selesai, Dibatalkan)
Edit Konten Landing Page: Admin CMS interface to update product photo, hero title, add new flavor, edit flavor name, price, badge, and upload/change flavor images
Live Chat Admin Panel: Simulated customer chat drawer allowing admin to respond to customer inquiries directly

testing_attributes.requirement: All interactive elements and key text nodes MUST include data-testid in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a high-craft Awwwards-level landing page for MilkyWay with an integrated admin panel.
Ensure all user choices are strictly respected: Bahasa Indonesia language, 350ml bottle, 10 milk flavors, price Rp 15.000 per bottle, WhatsApp 081227646940, strictly NO medical/health claims.
Implement the mix-flavor cart feature allowing buyers to mix multiple flavors with custom quantities in a single order, saving to backend API database and offering direct WhatsApp trigger.
Admin panel must support visitor stats chart, order status management, and landing page content editing.
All components must use modern Tailwind CSS styling, smooth transitions, and data-testid attributes.
